title: F10 — Reports and audit log
tagline: a signed, branded PDF and a CSV from one session snapshot; every sensitive action written to an HMAC-chained audit log.

series.name: SiteLog: an iOS app and its API, built

intro: Sprint S6 · 37h · skeleton guide — full code is added when this feature starts.
Code in this guide is a teaching example. Check current source and follow F00 localization rules before applying it.

blocks.html:
• Goal: a signed, branded PDF and a CSV from one session snapshot; every sensitive action written to an HMAC-chained audit log.
  • Demo — offline: session → report builder → branding → two signatures → PDF + CSV shared in airplane mode; the audit chain verifies at launch.
  • Demo — signed in: branding appears on the second device; the code printed in the PDF resolves at GET /verify/:code.
  • Spec: 05 Export, 07.3 Audit log, 03-backend §8
  • Starts from: F08 and F09 (issues, pairs, markup) and the skeleton Presentation/Reports/.
  • Steps: How every feature runs.
